_meanings:
The height of the vehicle animal in comparison with that
 of the principal idol; {#mUlaberavaSaM mAnamutsavodayamIritam#} (<ls>Māna. 64. 91-93</ls>).
Image for procession (Koṇḍavīḍu Inscription of Kṛṣṇarāya).

({%m.%} <ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a people, a wild tribe of the Himālaya;
 {#SarErutsavasaNketAn sa kftvA viratotsavAn#} <ls>R. 4. 78</ls>.
